components.css: .ds-journal { background:var(--journal-bg,#eeecf6); color:var(--journal-ink,#221f29); font-family:var(--font-sans,"Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable",sans-serif); padding:1rem; } .ds-record { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) minmax(5rem,.35fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:1rem; padding-block:1.48rem; border-block:1px solid var(--journal-line,#c9c3d3); color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-record strong { display:block; font:600 clamp(1.65rem,2.4vw,2.25rem)/1.1 var(--font-display,"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif); } .ds-record time,.ds-record small { color:#504659; font:.76rem/1.6 var(--font-mono,"JetBrains Mono Variable",monospace); } .ds-arrow { display:grid; place-items:center; width:2.4rem; height:2.4rem; border:1px solid #bbb0c6; border-radius:50%; } .ds-record:hover strong { color:var(--journal-violet,#6542a6); } .ds-record:hover .ds-arrow { background:var(--journal-violet,#6542a6); color:white; } @media(max-width:680px){ .ds-record { grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; } .ds-record > small { grid-row:2; grid-column:2; } .ds-arrow { grid-column:3; grid-row:1/3; }} .ds-journal :focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--journal-deep,#4c3388); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: The default presentation lays out Vũ Chí Thành’s work as a research journal. A graphite CRT with a lilac wireframe landscape sits opposite the introduction. Small registration marks frame the image and a quotation sits beneath it.
keyCharacteristics: The deep-plum activity band gives the latest result, its date, credits, and source a single place on the page.
Research entries sit on flat ruled rows with visible years, identifiers, and attribution.
Classic uses dark surfaces, monospaced headings, bright accents, and its own research-card grid.
dos: Do keep attribution, identifiers, and source links legible when rows reflow.
Do use the active presentation’s palette and preserve its keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep screen-only navigation and controls outside the printed résumé.
